_comment: Seed list of NATIONAL NFL insiders for the reporter directory. This file is deliberately small and explicit so a reviewer can diff it and click every link. Nothing here is presented as machine-verified on its own: on each build (a) Bluesky handles are resolved against the keyless public AppView and only marked 'verified' when the returned profile carries a valid Bluesky verification AND matches the name; lookalikes carrying Bluesky's own 'impersonation'/'parody' labels are surfaced as warnings; (b) X has no free verification API (publish.twitter.com/oembed returned HTTP 403 on 2026-09-10), so X rows are always one-click manual-review links and are labelled as such until an oEmbed probe succeeds in CI; (c) names are cross-checked against reporters actually named in the live ESPN injury feed (observed_in_feed). Outlets below are recorded only where observed directly (ESPN attribution text or the account's own verified bio); otherwise role is left generic.

national.name: Adam Schefter
national.outlet_evidence: Listed as 'ESPN' in live ESPN injury-feed attributions collected 2026-09-10 (data/latest/claims.json).
national.notes: Bluesky search on 2026-09-10 returned only mirrors/bots; the lookalike adamschefter.bsky.social carries Bluesky's own 'impersonation' moderation label. No genuine Bluesky account is linked.
